description: This file defines the DockIconManager class, which manages the visibility of the application's Dock icon based on window visibility and user preferences. It observes window events and user defaults changes to update the Dock icon policy accordingly.

classes.name: DockIconManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the visibility of the application's Dock icon based on window state and user preferences.

methods.name: updateDockVisibility
methods.description: Evaluates the current window states and user preferences to set the application's activation policy, showing or hiding the Dock icon accordingly.

methods.name: temporarilyShowDock
methods.description: Temporarily sets the application to display the Dock icon.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Initializes observers for window changes and user defaults updates to trigger visibility updates.

methods.name: windowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handler called when window visibility changes, triggering a Dock icon visibility update.

methods.name: dockPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handler called when user preferences change, updating the Dock icon visibility.
